attributes.name: Druva - Administrator Login Outside Normal Hours
attributes.description: Detects Druva administrator authentication outside an initial normal-hours window of 07:00–19:00.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.external_dependency: Threat intelligence / VPN-TOR enrichment; GeoIP/location enrichment
meta.customer_usecase: Detects Druva administrator authentication outside an initial normal-hours window of 07:00–19:00.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Admin Login"

| EVAL admin = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.name),
    TO_STRING(user.email)
  )

| EVAL login_ip = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip)
  )

| EVAL location =
    TO_STRING(source.ip)

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL login_hour =
    DATE_EXTRACT(
      "hour_of_day",
      event_time
    )

| WHERE login_hour < 7
    OR login_hour >= 19
